item.tib: dbal phur 'bar ba nag po rin chen gter mdzod las 'dzab them sngags kyi sbam bu
item.coloph: brgyud 'dzin rnams kyi bkrol 'byed dam/ sngags gong 'og nor tshul gyi/ gab dkrug mkhyen rnams bsnyom kyang / lag len rtsing por mthong pa dog pas/ grogs po gshen rgyal bstan 'dzin gyis bskul ngor/ lcags bya cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes bzang por/ kho bo bde chen gling pas spel ba dge'o//
